item.title: By: Ben J

item.description: "As someone who’s picky about matcha, I have to say this is worth every penny. The taste is earthy but not bitter, and it’s wonderful in smoothies or on its own

item.title: By: Carla D
item.dc:creator: Carla D
item.description: This matcha is excellent! Super smooth and bright green in color, which shows it’s top quality. It blends well and tastes amazing in my morning latte.
